text:
toni: Heads-up — partner demo using the nextjs-agent-starter is flaky when tokens rotate. Observed duplicated agent actions + doubled eval metrics when SDK does automatic retries.

arpan: Can you sketch the flow? Is this during SSR or client edge?

toni: Edge runtime + client-side agent. Flow: user request -> next api route -> LangChain adapter -> redwood client.generate (stream). If token refresh happens mid-flight the client retries and the agent loop sometimes replays the same tool call twice (e.g., two identical search calls).

yasmin: that sounds bad for evals. Where are duplicates surfacing?

toni: In our eval harness we count tool invocations to measure latency and QPS. After a retry-induced duplicate, the harness sees two search calls and marks the eval as non-deterministic. The partner demo also shows double results in the chat window.

arpan: do we have logs? a minimal repro would help.

toni: quick log fragment: `agent.run() -> tool:search q="how to bake sourdough"` then `401 token_expired -> sdk retry` then later `agent.run() -> tool:search q="how to bake sourdough"` (same idempotency missing). Seems the agent loop isn't pausing/reconciling in-flight requests on retry.

yasmin: Node SDK has had an idempotency header added for HTTP retries. Edge/browser client parity is still pending afaik. If the edge client doesn't reuse an idempotency key, runtime treats retries as new requests and agent loop re-executes tools.

toni: workaround idea: make the starter agent wrapper attach a local per-request runId and have the tool-adapter ignore duplicate tool calls with same runId+toolName. Not ideal but quick for demos.

arpan: agree as short-term. Long-term: SDK parity — expose retry hooks and consistent idempotency across runtimes. Also SDK could expose a small middleware to annotate agent runs with an id so replays are detectable.

yasmin: also add an e2e eval test: simulate token expiry in the next dev server by returning 401 on first attempt and 200 on retry, assert only one tool invocation recorded. Put test at `tests/evals/retry-tool.spec.ts`.

ci-bot: ci: 2 failing eval runs in the last hour for branch next-agent/retry-fix. See https://ci.internal.redwood/evals/2771 (truncated).

ops-bot: telemetry: adding a metric `agent.dup_tool_invocations` to track duplicates per environment, tagging by starter name.

arpan: i'll open a micro PR to add runId to the starter agent and the e2e. We'll also add a note in README: "If you rely on client-side retries, set a stable run id or idempotency header to avoid duplicate tool calls."

toni: preview patch (local):
```diff
- const result = await agent.run(input)
+ const runId = headers['x-run-id'] || crypto.randomUUID()
+ const result = await agent.run({ input, meta: { runId } })
```

yasmin: perfect. Once PR lands, update the eval harness to mock the expired token flow so this doesn't regress.

arpan: will also add a small note to SDK parity board: EDGE-RETRY-IDEMPOTENCY + AGENT-RUN-META.

toni: thanks all — pushing the temp fix to the demo branch and adding the e2e. Will remove workaround when SDK parity lands. :rocket:
